integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Hand-painted 2D anime cel animation: clean confident linework, flat cel shading with soft painted backgrounds, rich pink and teal neon light, steady diagonal rain and wet reflective rooftops at night. The courier girl has a short black bob, a bright yellow raincoat with the hood down and a dark green messenger bag; the three ninjas wear all black with red scarves over their faces. Characters keep the same proportions, outlines and colors in every frame. The shot begins exactly on Picture 1 and the camera stays locked off. The girl stays crouched on the catwalk, breathing hard; the billboard light pulses gently; the train keeps rolling past below; the three ninjas stand motionless at the far end; rain falls. Gentle idle motion only. The shot settles into the final composition of Picture 2 and holds: the girl crouched on the catwalk seen from behind, the giant glowing pink and blue billboard, the elevated train passing below on the right, the red and white antenna on the left, and the three ninjas standing at the far left end of the catwalk.

overall_soundscape: Steady rain on steel grating, the rumble of the train below, a low electric hum from the billboard, her breathing.
